questions.stem: What property of water molecules allows them to form a continuous column in the xylem?

options.text: Water molecules can only move in one direction
Water molecules are attracted to each other by hydrogen bonds (cohesion)
Water molecules repel each other, pushing them upwards
Water molecules are lighter than air

questions.explanation: Cohesion is the attraction between water molecules due to hydrogen bonds. This allows water to form a continuous, unbroken column in the xylem, so when water is pulled from the top, the whole column moves upward.
